prompt: If a volunteer compared the midway photograph with the projection instead of using both photos at the big table, what would that comparison fail to establish about the stripe?
promptZh: 如果志工改拿清潔到一半的照片和投影對照，而不用大桌上的兩張照片，會無法確認條紋的哪一點？
evidence: “The old photograph beside the projector was sharp enough to recover the outline of the large letters, but not the thinner details.” / “Back at the big table, one photo shows the uncleaned sign, and the other shows it halfway through cleaning.” / “The narrow stripe next to the letters first became visible in that second photo.” / “It isn’t on the projection.”
explanationZh: 投影以較早、看不清細節的照片為依據，並不是本次清潔前的現況紀錄。要確認清潔之前是否看得見，得比較清潔前與進行中的兩張照片。

options.text: That the stripe was not visible before the team started cleaning the sign
options.zh: 在團隊開始清潔招牌之前，條紋並未顯露。
options.whyZh: 投影以較早、看不清細節的照片為依據，並不是本次清潔前的現況紀錄。要確認清潔之前是否看得見，得比較清潔前與進行中的兩張照片。

options.text: That the stripe can be seen in the photo taken during cleaning
options.zh: 清潔到一半時拍的照片看得見條紋。
options.whyZh: 清潔到一半的照片本身就能顯示條紋，無須再用清潔前的照片確認這件事。

options.text: That the projection does not include the stripe
options.zh: 投影並未呈現那道條紋。
options.whyZh: 投影上有沒有條紋，可以直接看投影；比較能確認的是它確實沒畫出條紋，而非招牌在清潔前的狀態。

options.text: That the stripe is beside the large letters in the midway photograph
options.zh: 清潔到一半的照片裡，條紋就在大字母旁邊。
options.whyZh: 清潔到一半的照片本身可以看出條紋在字母旁；缺少清潔前照片並不影響判定條紋的位置。
